app.title: TVHeadend Recordings
common.no_data: No data – please check the settings.
hdr.new_rec_tip: Schedule a recording with a fixed channel and fixed times
ar.title: Title: {t}
ar.confirm_delete:
Delete series recording “{name}”?
Programmes already recorded are kept.
ar.preview_n: Matches {n} programmes in the programme data
ar.preview_many: That is a lot ({n}) – maybe the rule is too wide (make the title more exact, set a channel or time).
ar.preview_none: No programme in the programme data matches – the rule only takes effect once a matching one appears.
ar.preview_off: The rule is disabled – it schedules nothing until it is enabled again.
miss.none: No entries with a missing file.
miss.hint: Only entries whose file is really missing are deleted. Video files are never touched.
common.title: Title
unk.none: All files in the recording folder are registered in TVHeadend.
unk.subtitle: Subtitle / episode
unk.confirm_bulk: Add {n} files with the suggested titles and times?
st.failed_full: {n} recording(s) failed in the last 30 days because the disk was full.
st.recep_hint: Bars: signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) per hour, red from the top: reception errors. If all transponders are affected at the same time, it is usually the weather – only some: dish or transponder.
st.recep_none: No measurements and no recordings yet. Measured every minute while a tuner is working.
up.conflicts_hint: More channels from different transponders are to be recorded at the same time than there are tuners ({n}). At least one recording will fail – affected ones are marked red.
up.confirm_stop: Stop the running recording “{t}”? What has been recorded so far is kept.
up.confirm_delete: Delete the scheduled recording “{t}” on {day} at {time}?
up.overnight: If the end is before the begin (e.g. 23:00–01:00), the recording runs into the next day.
up.conflict_msg: Conflict: {n} other recording(s) on other transponders are already scheduled at this time – but there are only {tuners} tuners:
up.alt_hint: Other broadcasts of the same programme. “Free” means: there are enough tuners at that time. Moving deletes the previous recording.
up.alt_hint_series: Other broadcasts of the same programme. “Free” means: there are enough tuners at that time. Moving disables the previous date of the series recording (not deleted, otherwise it would be scheduled again).
up.alt_none: No other broadcast found in the programme data.
up.alt_moved: Recording moved – the conflict is solved
up.alt_moved_clash: Recording moved – but there are not enough tuners there either
cfg.ui_lang_hint: More languages: add a file lang/xx.json (xx = language code) next to de.json and en.json.
cfg.epg_lang: Language code of the programme data
cfg.tvhconf: TVHeadend configuration folder (for the full backup)
cfg.player_int_hint: right here in the browser, on phone and PC
cfg.player_ext_msg: Playing with an external player (m3u file, e.g. VLC)
cfg.player_ext_hint: downloads an m3u file for VLC or similar
cfg.no_inline: This browser cannot use the internal player (e.g. iPhone) – the external one is always used here.
cfg.quality_hint: Applies to “Play” in Live TV, in the TV guide and – in the internal player – also to recordings. Every device remembers its own setting. The lower levels are transcoded by the computer – a small computer can usually do that for only one stream at a time. “Home” costs hardly any processing power for HD channels.
cfg.notify_hint: Via {link}: install the “ntfy” app, subscribe to a topic with a name that is hard to guess (e.g. {ex}) and enter the full address here. Anyone who knows the name can read along.
cfg.n_need_url: Please enter the ntfy address first
cfg.n_sent: Test message sent – it should appear on your phone shortly
cfg.trakt_hint: For films (and series) for which Wikipedia and TVmaze have no image. This needs a free “Client ID”: sign in at {site}, under {apps} enter e.g. {name} as name and {uri} as redirect URI, save – then paste the Client ID shown here (the “Client Secret” is not needed).
cfg.trakt_saved: Trakt Client ID saved – images will be loaded bit by bit
cfg.n_link: Address of this interface (for links in the messages, optional)
cfg.n_link_hint: Tapping a message opens the matching place, e.g. the deletion suggestions for “Disk almost full”. Preferably the address under which the interface can also be reached from outside.
bk.full_hint: Backs up the whole TVHeadend folder: recordings, channels, timers, tuners and users. After restoring, everything is exactly as before, including the watched status. Only fits the same hardware and the same or a newer TVHeadend version.
bk.json_hint: For a new installation with different hardware, version or recording folder. Run the channel scan in TVHeadend before importing so that the channels are found. Recordings get new IDs.
bk.auto_enable: Back up automatically every night (full backup, JSON export and EPG archive)
bk.dir: Folder (preferably on a different disk than the system)
bk.existing_hint: To restore: choose the file below under “Restore backup” or “Import file”.
bk.arch_hint: The past programmes for the TV guide are stored on the system drive. The nightly backup puts a copy into the folder above ({f}, replaced every night).
bk.arch_none: No copy yet – “Back up now” creates one.
bk.arch_restore_tip: Take over programmes from the copy that are missing in the archive – existing ones stay unchanged
bk.arch_restore: Complete the archive from the copy
bk.arch_confirm: Take over programmes from the copy that are missing in the archive? Existing ones stay unchanged.
bk.arch_added: {n} programmes taken over from the copy
bk.arch_complete: The archive was already complete – nothing to take over
bk.done: Backed up: {f} ({mb} MB), JSON export and EPG archive ({amb} MB)
bk.restore_confirm:
Restore “{f}”?

TVHeadend will be stopped, the current configuration folder will be renamed (not deleted) and replaced by the backup. Then TVHeadend restarts.
bk.restored: Backup restored. The previous folder is at {prev}
scan.never: No scan through this tool yet.
scan.hint: Scans all transponders for channels. New TV channels are suggested for adding – which languages and whether encrypted ones are included can be chosen after evaluating. New channels get numbers after the highest existing one. Channels whose services were no longer found in the scan can be deleted.
scan.confirm:
Start channel scan?
Depending on the number of transponders this takes 10–30 minutes. Free tuners are used; running recordings take priority.
scan.evaluating: Evaluating – checking audio tracks of the new services …
scan.enc_tip: encrypted – needs a CI module or a card reader
scan.no_new: No new channels found with this selection.
scan.other: Other version of an existing channel ({n})
scan.other_hint: SD, regional or country version of a channel you already have
scan.missing_tip: The transponder no longer lists the service in its channel directory (PAT/SDT) – TVHeadend has therefore disabled it
scan.all_found: All channels were found in the scan.
scan.no_signal: No signal: {m}. Channels on these transponders are listed above under “No longer found” – in bad weather better scan again later.
scan.del_autorec: Attention: {n} of them have series recordings.
scan.del_keep: Recordings of these channels are kept.
chn.hint: Drag a channel to another place with the mouse (on a phone, press and hold briefly, then drag). The channel gets the number after its new predecessor. If that number is taken, you are asked whether the following channels should move up until the next gap – otherwise the number is used twice (marked red). Double-click to change the number within the gap to its neighbours. TVHeadend is only changed with “Save”.
chn.range: Possible: {lo} to {hi} – the gap between the neighbours. To go further, drag the channel.
chn.no_room: The number of “{name}” cannot be changed: there is no gap between {a} and {b}. To change it, drag the channel to another place.
chn.no_room_first: The number of “{name}” cannot be changed: there is no gap before {b}. To change it, drag the channel to another place.
chn.follow_q: Should the {k} directly following channels up to the next gap also change by {d}?
chn.leave: The changed channel numbers have not been saved yet. Leave anyway?
chn.shift_q: Number {n} is already used by “{name}”. Should the following {k} channels move up by one until the next gap?
chn.shift_q1: Number {n} is already used by “{name}”. Should “{name}” move up to {m}?
chn.del_confirm: Delete channel “{name}” in TVHeadend? This cannot be undone.
chn.del_autorec: Attention, series recordings on this channel: {t}
chn.del_keep: Recordings of this channel are kept.
chn.unknown: Unknown channel – please reload the page
chn.list_tip: Channel list – applies to Live TV, TV guide and Tonight
chn.list_edit: Editing “{name}”: click channels to add or remove them
chn.list_ask: Name of the new channel list (e.g. Favourites):
chn.list_del_confirm: Delete list “{name}”? The channels themselves stay.
chn.list_name: Please enter a name (at most 40 characters)
chn.list_not_own: Only lists created here can be deleted here
pl.no_subs: No subtitles yet – not every programme has them (teletext page 150/777).
pl.aborted: Playback stopped ({err}). After an SD/HD switch or with weak reception “Reload” often helps.
pl.loading: Loading … (tuning the channel or preparing the recording takes a few seconds)
tt.copy_tip: Copy the text of the whole page to the clipboard
tt.hint: Page numbers in the text can be clicked, text can be selected with the mouse and copied. Typing digits jumps straight to a page.
tt.page_pending: Page {p} has not arrived yet – coming shortly …
rec.name: Name
rec.delete_tip: Delete this recording including its file
rec.confirm_delete: Permanently delete {n} recording(s) including the video file?
rec.confirm_replace:
Replace the video file of “{t}” with “{f}” ({size})?
The current file will be overwritten.
rec.dup_count: {n} programmes recorded more than once · {extra} copies preselected ({size}) – “Delete selected” removes them
rec.more_versions: click further versions in the list
rec.v_free_tip: Suggestions for deleting: watched ones first, then the oldest
epg.full_tip: Also search the subtitle and description of programmes, not just the title
ev.over_archived: This programme is over (from this tool’s archive).
ev.no_repeats: No further broadcast found in the programme data (it covers about 4 weeks ahead).
ev.no_repeats_ep: No further broadcast of this episode found in the programme data (it covers about 4 weeks ahead).
ev.past_ep: {n} earlier broadcast(s) of this episode in the archive
srv.arch_no_copy: No backup copy of the archive found: {path}
srv.arch_unreadable: Backup copy of the archive is not readable: {err}
srv.server_url: Server address must start with http:// or https://
srv.no_tvhconf: Not a TVHeadend configuration folder (file “config” missing): {dir}
srv.trakt_format: That does not look like a Client ID (long string of digits and letters)
srv.need_recdir: Please enter the recording folder under “Settings” first
srv.need_tvhconf: Please enter the TVHeadend configuration folder under “Settings” first
srv.event_gone: Programme no longer in the guide
srv.rec_not_created: TVHeadend did not create a recording (already scheduled or programme over?)
srv.end_after_start: The end must be after the begin
srv.end_in_past: The end is in the past
srv.too_long: Longer than 12 hours – please check the times
srv.manual_not_created: TVHeadend did not create the recording
srv.autorec_too_wide: Please enter at least a title, channel, tag or content type – otherwise everything would be recorded
srv.autorec_not_created: TVHeadend did not create the series recording
srv.file_outside: File not found or outside the recording folder
srv.import_end_past: The end must be in the past, otherwise a recording timer would be created
srv.entry_not_created: TVHeadend did not create the entry: {f}
srv.edit_no_file: Video file missing, the description cannot be changed
srv.edit_old_failed: TVHeadend did not switch the old entry; nothing changed
srv.edit_new_failed: TVHeadend did not create the new entry; nothing changed
srv.replace_no_old: The current file is missing, replacing is not possible
srv.no_space_file: Not enough free space for the new file
srv.replace_path_failed: TVHeadend did not accept the new path; the old file is kept
srv.no_network: No network set up in TVHeadend
srv.no_scan: No channel scan started through this tool yet
srv.not_tvh_backup: The archive is not a TVHeadend backup (file “config” missing)
srv.tvh_no_restart: TVHeadend does not respond after the restart
srv.no_space_backup: Not enough free space for the backup
srv.version_differs: The backup comes from TVHeadend {old}, installed is {new}. Restore anyway?
srv.restore_manual: Nothing changed. To do it by hand (copy the backup to /tmp):
srv.need_backup_dir: Please enter a folder for the backups
srv.ntfy_url: Please enter the full ntfy address, e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-secret-topic
srv.no_backup_dir: No folder set for the backups
srv.backup_running: A backup is running right now
srv.n_disk_text: Only {gb} GB free ({pct} %). New recordings may fail.
srv.no_teletext: This channel does not broadcast teletext
srv.no_stream_url: TVHeadend does not provide a stream address
srv.stream_failed: Stream cannot be started (channel not receivable or file damaged?)
srv.too_many_encodes: Two transcoded streams are already running – the computer cannot do more. Please stop one or choose quality “Home” for HD channels.
srv.not_export: Not an export file of tvh-aufnahmen
srv.imp_scan_first: run the channel scan in TVHeadend first
srv.imp_channel_failed: TVHeadend did not create the channel
srv.imp_autorec_failed: TVHeadend did not create the series timer
srv.imp_entry_failed: TVHeadend did not create the entry
ev.reminded: Reminder set – a message arrives on your phone 5 minutes before the start
cli.description: Web interface for TVHeadend: TV guide, recordings, live TV, backup. Folder and server can also be changed in the interface under “Settings”.
cli.service: systemd service that is stopped and started when restoring; empty = leave alone (default: %(default)s)
cli.running: Interface running on port {port}, address {bind} (Ctrl+C to quit)
pl.q_tip: Quality for this playback only – the setting for this device stays
pl.z_tip: Fit → Fill (crops the edges, e.g. black bars sent along) → continuous zoom – key Z
pl.fs_tip: Full screen – key F or double-click
pl.z_slider: Continuous zoom – also with the keys + and −
srv.no_users: Access from outside is only possible once a user has been created under “Settings” → “Sign-in”.
srv.login_blocked: Too many failed attempts – please try again in {min} minutes.
srv.bad_username: User name: 1–40 characters, only letters, digits, dot, hyphen, @ and _
srv.password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters
srv.bad_origin: Request from a foreign page rejected
auth.title: Sign-in
auth.hint: For access from the internet (port forwarding). The connection must be encrypted (HTTPS via a proxy), otherwise passwords travel through the network in plain text.
auth.local: This device is in the home network.
auth.mode_external: only from outside (home network and VPN without sign-in)
auth.mode_always: always, also in the home network
auth.mode_off: never (only run in the home network!)
auth.off_warn: Without sign-in anyone who can reach the interface can change and delete everything – do not expose it to the internet like this.
auth.no_users: No user yet – nobody gets in from outside until one is created.
auth.del_confirm: Delete user {u}? Their sessions will be ended.
login.title: Sign in
srv.always_needs_login: “Always” only works while you are signed in – otherwise you would be locked out at once. Please create a user and sign in first.
srv.last_user: The last user cannot be deleted while sign-in is always required.
srv.bad_regex: The title is not a valid regular expression: {err}
srv.link_url: The address of the interface must start with http:// or https://
srv.need_ntfy: For reminders, first enter the ntfy address under Settings → Notifications
tn.hint: What is on at 20:15 and afterwards – tap for details and recording
tn.none: There is no programme data for this evening (yet).
